about.title: Child care rooted in the neighborhood
body: Mrithun Child Care Clinic was built around a simple idea — that a visit to the doctor shouldn't be something a child dreads. Our team takes the time to explain, reassure, and involve parents in every step, whether it's a routine growth checkup or a worrying fever at odd hours.

Located on Mugalivakkam Main Road, we've become a trusted neighborhood clinic for families across the area, offering everything from newborn care and vaccination tracking to guidance on nutrition and everyday childhood illnesses — all under one familiar roof.

blogPosts.title: Your Child's First-Year Immunization Schedule, Explained Simply
blogPosts.excerpt: A plain-language walkthrough of what shots happen when, and why the schedule is built the way it is.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Arun Kumar
content: The first-year immunization schedule can look overwhelming on paper, but it's built around one simple principle: protecting your baby right when they're most vulnerable to each specific disease.

Most vaccines are given in a series, not a single dose, because the immune response builds over multiple exposures — the spacing between doses isn't arbitrary, it's designed to build the strongest possible protection.

It's normal for your baby to be fussy or run a mild fever for a day after certain vaccines. This is usually just the immune system doing exactly what it's supposed to do, and it settles on its own within a day or two.
We maintain a record of your child's immunizations at the clinic and will remind you at each visit when the next dose is due, so you never have to keep track of the schedule on your own.
If you're ever unsure about a specific vaccine or worried about a reaction, call us or ask at the visit — we'd always rather spend a few extra minutes explaining than have you leave with questions.
